name: dig-up
title: Dig Up
description: Search your files by what's in them: photos, screenshots, PDFs, notes, recordings, videos and code. Runs on your Mac with Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2.
author: ladislav_husty

commands.name: search
commands.title: Dig Up
commands.subtitle: Search Files by Meaning
commands.description: Describe a file in your own words and find it: a scene in a photo, a moment in a recording or video, a page of a PDF, or code by what it does (start with "code:").

commands.name: search-pictures
commands.title: Dig Up Pictures
commands.subtitle: Search Files in a Grid
commands.description: The same search in a picture grid, with kind filters.

commands.name: folders
commands.title: Dig Up Folders
commands.subtitle: Choose What Dig Up Searches
commands.description: Pick the folders to search and the code folders, see how long the first pass takes, and skip folders or file types.

commands.name: status
commands.title: Dig Up Status
commands.subtitle: Indexing Progress in the Menu Bar
commands.description: Shows how indexing is going, and lets you pause it or index now.

commands.name: index-now
commands.title: Dig Up: Index Now
commands.description: Look for new and changed files in your folders now.

commands.name: toggle-pause
commands.title: Dig Up: Pause or Resume Indexing
commands.description: Pause indexing until you resume it.

commands.name: rebuild-index
commands.title: Dig Up: Rebuild Index
commands.description: Embed every file again (search by name keeps working meanwhile).

preferences.name: codeEditor
preferences.title: Code Editor
preferences.description: Where code results open, at the line.

preferences.name: mediaPlayer
preferences.title: Recordings and Videos
preferences.description: Where audio and video results open. QuickTime Player and IINA start at the matching moment.

preferences.name: indexOnBattery
preferences.title: Indexing
preferences.label: Index on battery power
preferences.description: Off: the first pass waits for the charger. New files are always read.

preferences.name: indexHours
preferences.title: Index Hours
preferences.description: Only index between these hours, e.g. 22-7. Empty: any time. Search works at any time.

preferences.name: llamaServerPath
preferences.title: llama-server
preferences.description: Optional: a llama.cpp llama-server (build b11452 or newer). Empty: Dig Up downloads llama.cpp b11624.

preferences.name: modelFolder
preferences.title: Model Folder
preferences.description: Optional: a folder with embeddinggemma-2-Q8_0.gguf and mmproj-embeddinggemma-2-Q8_0.gguf. Empty: Dig Up uses DigUp's or the Hugging Face cache's copy, or downloads them.

scripts.dev: npm run build:helper && npm run build:engine && ray develop
